Breaking severe weather strong thunderstorms some severe moving through New York New Jersey
We are seeing some very heavy thunderstorms moving through the Northeast this afternoon and evening and some of these storms are severe. Most of the severe weather in New York State is from Interstate 90 to Albany southward. We have seen severe thunderstorms in the mix. Other thunderstorms are developing in New Jersey and Pennsylvania so there will be more showers, thunderstorms and severe weather this afternoon into tonight. The Storm Prediction Center continues to indicate a 15 percent chance for severe thunderstorms in the slight risk zone and a small but not zero risk of tornadoes from Northern New Jersey to New England.

Heartbroken Hound is Searching For New Home After Family Surrenders Her For Being "Too Loud"
Meet Maple Dixie, a sweet and gentle girl who is searching for her second chance at life after being let down by the people she loved most. Great Dog Rescue New England (GDRNE), a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently introduced Maple Dixie after she was given over to their care. According to the recuse, “She was surrendered after a year with a family she loved very much, through no fault of her own, because they found her ‘too loud’. She hasn’t been noisy at all in foster care, though she may find her voice once she’s settled. True hound lovers know their expressive natures are part of their charm, and Maple deserves a family who loves her for who she is.”
